status: fixed before any new-layer source-interchange training or evaluation
reason: align the actual generation intervention layer with the new generation objective; do not inherit only the old answer-selfcheck-selected layer
layer_rule: zero-based int(num_layers * fraction) - 1; fractions fixed to [0.5, 0.75]
source_system: Answer factual questions truthfully. Correct false premises rather than accepting them. Give a short, direct answer of a few words. If you do not know the answer, say 'I don't know'.

training.objective: mean gold-token CE within each answer, equal weight per question

reuse_policy: reuse only original baseline/source_only/equal_logit_mix raw outputs with parent raw SHA256 and exact prompt-token validation; regenerate both frozen swaps at each new layer
evaluation: all 192 previously exposed tuning questions; no test-set phase or test-based selection; report both additional layers, not only the maximum
scope: only these two additional layers; no full-layer search
